steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In February 2023, Equity Mates said Chrysos developed a novel gold assaying technology for the global mining and geochemistry lab industry with CSIRO, and reported 15 units deployed with expectations to reach 21 by FY23, indicating growing adoption.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In February 2023, Equity Mates noted unit economics continued to improve and utilisation was trending stronger than guidance, as the company reiterated deployment targets and updated FY23 prospectus growth forecasts.

episode.title: 23 Stocks for 2023 | Car Sales, Aussie Broadband and PayPal! Pt III

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In February 2023, Equity Mates highlighted strong cash receipts, lower cash costs and an $81.1 million cash balance, and said the company was exploring debt funding to support further roll out of units.

episode.title: 23 Stocks for 2023 | Car Sales, Aussie Broadband and PayPal! Pt III

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In February 2023, a guest on Equity Mates discussed valuation using a 10 year DCF with a 9.2% WACC, and said the stock traded at 6.6 times NTM EV/sales and 9.9 times FY25 EBITDA while targeting 10 times EV/sales and 16.8 times EBITDA, assuming 82% revenue growth by FY25.
